A small dragon stirs atop a glittering hoard deeper in the chamber, one eye cracking open.
A pressure-plate clicks and a volley of darts streaks from holes in the wall.
A magical glyph flares to life on the floor beneath the party's feet, glowing red.
A skeleton slumps against the far wall, still clutching a torch burned down to nothing.
A thin shaft of pale light falls from a crack far above, catching drifting dust motes.
A rope bridge stretches over a chasm so deep its bottom swallows all torchlight completely.
A translucent figure drifts through the stone wall, mouth open in a silent, endless scream.
Dark water seeps under the sealed door and spreads quickly across the cold dungeon floor.
A portcullis crashes down behind the rearmost adventurer, iron teeth biting into the stone floor.
The carved stone statue's eyes suddenly flood with amber light, tracking every movement in the room.
A torrent of rats pours shrieking from a side-tunnel, flooding across the party's boots.
A spiked ceiling panel groans and begins its slow, grinding descent toward the chamber floor.
The floor section ahead splits with a crack and drops away into absolute roaring darkness below.
A coiled dragon raises its horned head from a mound of coins, scales glinting like embers.
Crossbow bolts snap from concealed slots in the walls the instant the trip-wire catches a boot.
A warding rune blazes violet on the threshold, humming with barely-contained destructive arcane energy.
Rusted armor and scattered bones mark where an adventurer fell and was never recovered or mourned.
Pale golden light angles down through a ceiling crack, illuminating an otherwise pitch-black forgotten alcove.
Ancient stone arches span a bottomless rift, each keystone cracked and threatening to give way.
A ghost in tattered robes hovers at the corridor's end, pointing one skeletal finger ahead.
Muddy water pours from wall grates and rises fast, already swirling around the party's ankles.
A heavy iron gate slams down, sealing the only visible exit with a reverberating iron clang.
Twin gemstone eyes in a carved demon-face glow a deep, warning crimson in the dark.
Thousands of beetles boil out of a crack in the wall, clicking and swarming the floor.
A small dragon lifts its snout, exhales a lazy curl of smoke, and watches them hungrily.
